origin: Cohort a5 (claude-sonnet-5-thinking-xhigh) converted twelve registered hypotheses into twelve executed two-arm reproductions and two independently recurrence-tested mechanism changes. Its deterministic simulation testing found a fence-token collision in the coordinator's cmd_lease that sequential fault injection missed entirely: 84 of 90 exhaustive and 298 of 300 sampled violations, against 0 of 24 by sequential injection. a5 also recorded two honest boundaries that the coordinator must close rather than accept.

source_hashes.note: Pinned by commit, per the a12-u02 remediation.

units.hypothesis: cmd_lease reads the current fence token, computes its successor and appends in three unsynchronised steps, so concurrent lease grants for the same unit mint identical fence tokens and the fencing mechanism can no longer distinguish one holder from another.

acceptance.assertion: A fence token is issued at most once per unit, guaranteed under concurrency rather than by convention. Proven by concurrent multi-process lease grants for the same unit where every granted lease carries a distinct, strictly increasing fence token and any loser is refused and durably recorded. Reproduced by the coordinator on 2026-08-22: three concurrent grants all minted fence token 1, so three holders shared one fence. Note this is a distinct invariant from ledger sequence-number uniqueness in a11-u02: the chain verified clean while fence uniqueness broke, so a11-u02 passing does not imply this unit passes.
acceptance.artifact: atomically issued fence tokens plus a concurrent multi-process recurrence test
acceptance.falsified_if: any two lease grants for one unit can share a fence token, or a refused grant leaves no durable record

units.rationale: Fencing is the control that makes single-writer ownership real. If two holders can share a fence, every downstream stale-worker protection is decorative under concurrency.

units.hypothesis: The causal-defect coding that returned NOT_YET against a 148-row ledger with zero completion-adjacent rows can now be decided, because the ledger has grown past 390 rows with many terminal transitions, ingestions, corrections and provider failures.

acceptance.assertion: The coder is re-run against an explicitly pinned ledger head rather than live state, per the binding anti-snapshot-coupling rule, and reports a decided category distribution with explicit numerator and denominator, or a further NOT_YET with the exact remaining data boundary. The earlier finding that discretionary_persistence rather than producer_self_certification was the plurality category in the historical evidence must be either confirmed or overturned against the new data, and the original NOT_YET must be preserved as evidence rather than overwritten.
acceptance.artifact: re-run coding output pinned to a ledger head hash plus an updated reproduction-ledger row
acceptance.falsified_if: the re-run asserts a verdict against live state, or the earlier NOT_YET is overwritten rather than superseded

units.hypothesis: a5's two mechanism changes survive recurrence testing by a genuinely different owner, not merely by a different process and seed under the same worker.

acceptance.assertion: Both mechanism changes, the property and mutation harness from a5-u06 and the deterministic simulation scheduler from a5-u07, are re-executed by this reviewer from a pinned commit on a5's branch and receive an independent RETAIN, DELETE, SUPERSEDE, RETEST or REJECT with lineage to a5's original reproduction-ledger row hashes. a5 recorded honestly that its own recurrence testing was independent-process and independent-seed but not different-owner, and marked that a NOT_YET boundary rather than claiming it satisfied; this unit closes it. The commission requires at least three independently supported lessons to change live mechanisms and receive recurrence tests, so state explicitly how many are now independently supported.
acceptance.artifact: independent recurrence transcripts plus dispositions with lineage
acceptance.falsified_if: the recurrence test is read rather than executed, or a disposition lacks lineage to a5's original row hash
